zh.title: 中國商飛C919高原型客機在上海完成首飛測試
zh.summary: 中國商飛研發的C919高原型客機於2026年7月29日在上海浦東國際機場完成首次測試飛行。該原型機註冊號為B-002U，機型名稱為C919-600，飛行時間為1小時59分鐘。中國商飛表示，該機型完成所有預定測試科目，標誌著C919系列化發展邁出重要一步。
body: 中國商飛（COMAC）於2026年7月29日在上海完成新型C919高原型客機的首次測試飛行。該架原型機型號為C919-600，註冊號為B-002U，當日由上海浦東國際機場起飛，在完成1小時59分鐘的飛行任務後返回降落。
根據中國商飛發布的訊息，該機型在首飛中完成了所有預定的測試科目。C919-600是以基礎型C919為基礎進行設計，機身結構縮短六個框位，並優化相關系統功能以滿足高海拔地區的營運需求。
該型高高原客機規劃載客量為140至160人，目前由中國商飛與西藏航空共同合作開發，標誌著C919系列化客機研製工作取得重要進展。

en.title: COMAC C919 High-Altitude Variant Completes Maiden Flight in Shanghai
en.summary: Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC) has completed the maiden test flight of its C919 high-altitude variant in Shanghai on July 29, 2026. The prototype aircraft, designated as the C919-600 and registered B-002U, took off from Shanghai Pudong International Airport and flew for 1 hour and 59 minutes. According to COMAC, the aircraft completed all scheduled test flight maneuvers. The C919-600 features a shortened fuselage and modified onboard systems designed for high-altitude operations, with a passenger capacity between 140 and 160 seats. The aircraft is being jointly developed with Tibet Airlines.
body: Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC) completed the maiden test flight of its new C919 high-altitude variant in Shanghai on July 29, 2026. The prototype aircraft, designated as the C919-600 and registered B-002U, took off from Shanghai Pudong International Airport and landed back at the airport after a flight duration of one hour and 59 minutes.

COMAC stated that the aircraft completed all scheduled test flight maneuvers during its initial flight. Based on the standard baseline model, the C919-600 incorporates targeted system adjustments and a shortened fuselage, with six frames removed, to meet operational requirements at high-altitude airports.

The C919-600 variant is designed with a seating capacity between 140 and 160 passengers. The high-altitude aircraft is being jointly developed by COMAC and Tibet Airlines as part of the C919 series development program.

zh.title: Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 於 Wichita 完成首飛
zh.summary: Textron Aviation 宣布 Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 原型機於 2026 年 7 月 29 日自 Wichita 起飛，進行近兩小時的首飛，最大高度達 41,000 英尺，正式展開飛測階段，目標取得 FAA 認證並於 2027 年投入服務。
body: Textron Aviation 於 2026 年 7 月 29 日宣布，Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 原型機完成首次飛行，標誌該輕型商務噴射機進入飛行測試階段。該機自 Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport 起飛，飛行時間近兩小時。
試飛員 Steve Helmer 與 Dave Welbrock 在此次飛行中主要評估駕駛艙軟體。飛機最大高度達 41,000 英尺，最高指示空速為 278 節。Helmer 表示，從起飛到降落，飛機展現了預期的操控品質與系統性能，為後續擴大測試與認證計畫奠定基礎。
CJ3 Gen3 保留 Garmin G3000 航電平台，並新增 Garmin 自動油門與 Emergency Autoland 功能。Emergency Autoland 可在飛行員失能時接管飛機、選擇合適機場、與航管通訊並在無飛行員介入下自動降落。Textron 另提供選配的增強視覺系統，以提升低能見度下的環境警覺能力。
Textron 將展開更廣泛的飛測活動，朝 FAA 認證與投入服務邁進。此次首飛意味 Textron 次世代 Citation 輕型噴射機系列三款機型均已進入飛行測試，其中 Citation CJ4 Gen3 已於 2024 年 10 月首飛，Citation M2 Gen3 則於 2026 年稍早完成首飛。
Textron 於 2024 年拉斯維加斯 NBAA 商務航空大會暨展覽中，與 M2 Gen3 及 CJ4 Gen3 一同發表 CJ3 Gen3。公司表示 CJ3 Gen3 與 M2 Gen3 預計於 2027 年投入服務。

en.title: Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 Completes First Flight in Wichita
en.summary: Textron Aviation announced the first flight of the Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 prototype on July 29, 2026, from Wichita, lasting nearly two hours and reaching 41,000 feet. The light business jet enters flight testing as Textron works toward FAA certification and entry into service in 2027.
body: Textron Aviation announced on July 29, 2026 that the first Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 prototype had completed its initial flight, moving the light business jet into the start of its flight-testing phase. The aircraft departed from Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport in Kansas for a flight lasting nearly two hours.

Test pilots Steve Helmer and Dave Welbrock focused primarily on evaluating cockpit software during the flight. The aircraft reached a maximum altitude of 41,000 feet and a top indicated airspeed of 278 knots. Helmer said the aircraft demonstrated the handling qualities and system performance the team expected, providing a strong foundation for expanded testing and the certification program.

The CJ3 Gen3 retains the Garmin G3000 avionics platform while adding Garmin autothrottles and Emergency Autoland. Emergency Autoland can take control of the aircraft if the pilot becomes incapacitated, select a suitable airport, communicate with air traffic control and land without pilot input. Textron also offers an optional enhanced vision system designed to improve situational awareness in reduced visibility.

Textron will now begin a broader flight-test campaign as it works toward Federal Aviation Administration certification and entry into service. The first flight means all three aircraft in Textron's next-generation Citation light jet lineup are undergoing flight testing. The Citation CJ4 Gen3 prototype first flew in October 2024, and the Citation M2 Gen3 completed its first flight earlier in 2026.

Textron introduced the CJ3 Gen3 alongside the M2 Gen3 and CJ4 Gen3 at the 2024 NBAA Business Aviation Convention and Exhibition in Las Vegas. The company has said the CJ3 Gen3 and M2 Gen3 are expected to enter service in 2027.
